issues.on_page: Line 18 Local Receipts: Other, WATER FUND column 62,665.64
issues.issue: This is the only local receipt in the Water Fund column, so it is almost certainly water charges ('charges for services/fees'). The printed label is 'Other', so 'other' with review is defensible. As a result, 100% of business-type receipts are in 'other'. Also, original_label has '(Water Fund)' added, which is not printed on the row; the same applies to receipts[10] and disbursements[3-5].
